cabin_items.value: At the aircraft, all bags including carry-on items are stowed in the cargo area. Only very small items that fit in the seat-back pocket may be carried into the cabin.

counted_weight.value: Small bags like purses and briefcases count towards your fare's weight allowance.

modules.title: Checked baggage

float_allowance.value: Scheduled float operations, allowance by fare: Light 10 lbs, Value 15 lbs, Comfort 25 lbs, Flex 50 lbs.

wheeled_allowance.value: Wheeled flights (YVR South Terminal/YYJ and YVR South Terminal/YAZ): Light 15 lbs, Value 30 lbs, Comfort 45 lbs, Flex 60 lbs.

piece_weight.value: Individual bags may not weigh more than 50lbs each; there is no restriction on the number of items.

additional.value: Additional baggage is $3/lb, subject to availability (standby on wheeled flights). On international flights all baggage must travel with the passenger.

max_dimensions.value: Maximum piece size by aircraft (width x length x height): Twin Otter 25" x 36" x 36"; Single Otter 18" x 42" x 54"; Caravan 19" x 12" x 30"; Beaver 23" x 34" x 14".

modules.lede: Your bags are weighed at check-in against your fare's maximum weight allowance.
